mapper.sql: e.id, e.event_name, e.event_type, e.event_date, e.start_location, e.distance_km, e.quota, e.registered_count, e.entry_fee, e.status, e.create_time, (e.quota - e.registered_count) AS remain_quota
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marathon_event (event_name, event_type, event_date, start_location, distance_km, quota, registered_count, entry_fee, status) VALUES (#{eventName}, #{eventType}, #{eventDate}, #{startLocation}, #{distanceKm}, #{quota}, 0, #{entryFee}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE marathon_event SET registered_count = registered_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND registered_count < quota
UPDATE marathon_event SET registered_count = registered_count - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND registered_count > 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 1
